description: This file implements functions for the 'SlapBmc2Command' object in a Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) environment. It provides methods to get the command name, retrieve and set command parameters by index, check if the command has been aborted, and remove all parameters. It appears to be part of a larger system related to BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) command processing.

methods.name: char * SlapBmc2ComoGetCommandName(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the command name associated with the command object by accessing the command property from the request controller context and cloning the string.

methods.name: SLAP_VARIABLE * SlapBmc2ComoGetParamByIndex(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_UINT32 param_index)
methods.description: Returns a copy of the parameter at the specified index from the CLI argument array, initializing the SLAP_VARIABLE structure with appropriate content.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2ComoRemoveAllParams(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes all CLI arguments from the request controller, effectively clearing command parameters.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapBmc2ComoSetParamByIndex(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_UINT32 param_index,char * param_value)
methods.description: Sets a command parameter at the specified index, expanding the argument list if necessary, and cloning the provided string into the argument array.

methods.name: SLAP_BOOL SlapBmc2ComoIsAborted(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Checks whether the command has been marked as aborted in the request controller.
